title: About Ten10
subtitle: Advanced system for managing tithes and simple, accurate financial budget management

appInfo.title: About the Application
appInfo.description: Ten10 is an advanced tithe management system, with automatic calculations, smart reminders, and detailed reports. It was developed with the Torat Ha'adam La'adam Institute and is halachically approved. The project grew out of the institute's Excel series for tithe and chomesh, with thousands of orders in Israel. At the request of many, a new system was built for more accurate and convenient tithe management.
appInfo.supportDescription: For running the site: development, maintenance, and ongoing costs. It can be given from ma'aser funds.

institute.title: Torat Ha’adam La’adam Institute
institute.description: The Torat Ha’adam La’adam Institute was founded to revive interpersonal commandments (Bein Adam Lechavero) and to disseminate the study and practical observance of these laws. The institute is the leader in the field of research of interpersonal commandments. The institute's activities include publishing books, delivering lectures, and providing halachic guidance on various topics, with the goal of increasing respect for others and Ahavat Yisrael. In addition, the institute guided the development of Ten10 and approved the accuracy of halachic calculations, ensuring the system meets all halachic requirements.

team.title: Development Team
team.description: Ten10's development team consists of experienced developers and leading programmers in the technology field. The team works in close collaboration with the Torat Ha’adam La’adam Institute to ensure complete halachic accuracy.

footer.title: Thank you for using Ten10
footer.description: We are proud to provide an advanced tool for managing tithes and simple, accurate financial budget management that helps give tithes and chomesh accurately and conveniently. Your feedback is very important to us!
